subject.authority: 09 Aegis Skill Decomposition & Multi-Skill Architecture v0.1

environment_preflight.note: Baseline characterization is complete: two protected probes PASS and two admissible protected probes FAIL on real ChatGPT Web selection events.

forbidden_substitutes: user-reported installation without a platform selection event
a routing probe whose stimulus names the expected selected or handoff Skill in a way that can bias platform auto-selection
acceptance.pass_rule: All four protected probes have real installed-platform evidence, with zero wrong selections, zero forbidden downstream execution, zero handoff loops, and no contaminated routing stimulus.

cases.reason: The installed platform selected the wrong specialist.

evidence.visible_ui_observation: Used aegis skill (twice); response returned BLOCKED_AUTHORITY and stopped substantive P14 design

defect_classification.summary: Routing-neutral direct P14 architecture request selects composite aegis instead of aegis-architecture.
defect_classification.suspected_boundary: Composite aegis trigger description claims direct architecture work and overwhelms the specialist-owned direct trigger

attempts.observed_behavior: Composite aegis reported BLOCKED_AUTHORITY, stopped substantive P14 design, and preserved the P12 blocker.

evidence.visible_ui_observation: Used aegis skill (twice); P14 System Architecture — Safety Preflight; Status BLOCKED_AUTHORITY

test_finding.summary: Probe 3 v0.1 stimulus named the expected final handoff owner ('central aegis'), contaminating the platform auto-selection measurement.

cases.reason: The routing-neutral v0.2 stimulus still selected the composite router instead of the architecture specialist. Safety behavior was correct, but initial Skill selection failed.

cases.prompt: Design the semantic schema and operation model for this feature.
cases.fixture: Only the composite aegis Skill is available to the conversation.
cases.precondition: The protected prompt is executed as an independent request in a composite-only Skill catalog

evidence.visible_ui_observation: Used aegis skill; routed to P12/P13 and failed closed with BLOCKED_MISSING_INPUT rather than depending on a specialist

cases.reason: The composite-only conversation safely handled a modeling-family request through aegis without specialist dependency and preserved upstream-authority fail-closed behavior.

root_cause_analysis.summary: The implemented discovery descriptions violate the approved Specific Skill Wins contract by advertising specialist-owned direct work from the composite/cross-cutting entrypoints.
evidence: composite aegis description explicitly advertises direct feature/architecture design, Gate audit, defect classification, and evidence-definition work
aegis-project-state description advertises generic Authority/Gate/Evidence/Integration records rather than staying scoped to .aegis manifests
aegis-architecture and aegis-gate-review own the failed direct requests but their descriptions are less discriminative than the competing general/cross-cutting descriptions
root_cause_analysis.repair_owner: Skill discovery metadata in canonical skillset sources
